findings.evidence: Line 212 `congr 2 <;> ring` is the only `congr n` in the whole repo (grep over `code/EpsilonEridani` returns this single hit); after the `simp only` the goal is `(-1 * Q / g p ℓ) • p + (1 * Q / g p' ℓ) • p' = Q • ((g p' ℓ)⁻¹ • p' - (g p ℓ)⁻¹ • p)`, exactly the shape `module` targets.
findings.fix: Drop both chains and finish with `module` after the `simp only` (line 212), and per summand at line 185 — the goals are plain `•`-linear combinations with scalar side conditions that `ring` discharges. `Mathlib/Tactic/Module.lean:763` provides `module` in the pinned Mathlib (`match_scalars` at :734 if the sum must be entered first).
findings.issue: `eikonalCurrent_chargedLine` reshapes the goal by hand (`rw [sub_eq_neg_add, ← neg_smul]`) purely so that `congr 2` splits it into two scalar goals; both rewrites are position-sensitive and `congr n` depends on the exact term shape `simp only` happens to leave. Same pattern at line 185, where `eikonalCurrent_smul` proves `sc / (c * x) • p = (c⁻¹ * (sc / x)) • p` with the chain `rw [div_mul_eq_div_div_swap, div_eq_mul_inv _ c, mul_comm _ c⁻¹]`, two of whose steps use positional placeholders.

findings.evidence: grep `LinearMap.sum_apply|map_sum, map_smul` in the file: hits at lines 167 and 193 with identical lemma lists; line 195 `rw [Finset.sum_comm]` carries no comment.
findings.fix: Add `apply_eikonalCurrent (g) (L) (ℓ v) : g (eikonalCurrent g L ℓ) v = ∑ i, (L i).signedCharge / g (L i).momentum ℓ * g (L i).momentum v` (and the mirrored `eikonalCurrent_apply` for the second slot), then derive `eikonalCurrent_conserved` by `div_mul_cancel₀` and `apply_eikonalCurrent_eikonalCurrent` by applying both, which fixes the sum order and removes `Finset.sum_comm`. The contraction `J·v` is needed anyway for the YFS material the PR description defers.
findings.issue: The step that contracts `eikonalCurrent` against a vector — `simp only [eikonalCurrent, map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]` — is repeated verbatim at lines 167 and 193, so the reusable fact `g (eikonalCurrent g L ℓ) v = ∑ i, (L i).signedCharge / g (L i).momentum ℓ * g (L i).momentum v` exists only inside two proofs. It also forces the unexplained `rw [Finset.sum_comm]` at line 195, which is there only to undo the summation order simp produced.

summary: Two proofs hand-normalize scalar arithmetic under `•` with `congr 2` and a three-lemma `rw` chain where Mathlib's `module` tactic closes the goal directly, and the contraction of `eikonalCurrent` against a vector is duplicated inline in two proofs instead of being a reusable lemma.
